task.title: Asking Questions with Conga Copilot for Documents Processed with Discovery AI
task.shortdesc: You must run Review Import Results before accessing Conga Copilot.

step.cmd: Within X-Author for Contracts Advanced, click the Work tab.
Click the More icon () on the left side of the navigation menu and select Review Import Results. You must run Review Import Results before accessing Conga Copilot.

note.p: You must run Review Import Results before accessing Conga Copilot.

step.cmd: Click Insights in the navigation menu.
Click the More icon () beside one of the results and select View Risk Details.
Under Need Help? click Conga Copilot.
Enter your question in the search box on the bottom. For example, "What is the Agreement Name?" and "What is the limitation of liability cap?"

note.p: The questions are retained until the document is checked-in again. Afterwards, they are deleted.

step.cmd: You can also click the More icon () on the left side of the navigation menu and select Conga Copilot to access this feature.
